mapper.select: SELECT SUM(event_type = 'EXPOSURE') AS exposures, SUM(event_type = 'CLICK') AS clicks FROM feed_event WHERE created_at >= #{since}
SELECT algorithm, SUM(event_type = 'EXPOSURE') AS exposures, SUM(event_type = 'CLICK') AS clicks FROM feed_event WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY algorithm ORDER BY algorithm

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(build_id, ':', 1) AS strategy, SUM(event_type = 'EXPOSURE') AS exposures, SUM(event_type = 'CLICK') AS clicks FROM feed_event WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND algorithm = 'AI' AND build_id IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(build_id, ':', 1) IN ('PREF', 'EXPLORE') GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY strategy

SELECT item_position AS position, SUM(event_type = 'EXPOSURE') AS exposures, SUM(event_type = 'CLICK') AS clicks FROM feed_event WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY item_position ORDER BY item_position
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM feed_event WHERE event_type = 'EXPOSURE' AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT AVG(category_count) FROM ( SELECT trace_id, user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) AS category_count FROM feed_event WHERE event_type = 'EXPOSURE' AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY trace_id, user_id ) traces
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT trace_id, user_id FROM feed_event WHERE event_type = 'EXPOSURE' AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY trace_id, user_id ) traces

SELECT CASE WHEN algorithm = 'RULE' AND build_id LIKE 'RULE:%' THEN 'CONTROL' ELSE 'AI' END AS grp, SUM(event_type = 'EXPOSURE') AS exposures, SUM(event_type = 'CLICK') AS clicks FROM feed_event WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND ( (algorithm = 'RULE' AND build_id LIKE 'RULE:%') OR (algorithm = 'AI' AND build_id IS NOT NULL AND (build_id LIKE 'PREF:%' OR build_id LIKE 'EXPLORE:%')) ) GROUP BY grp
